method: Manually adjudicated case evidence; references identify original append-only room message sequences. No counterfactual benefit rate is inferred.

cases.label: breakout opportunity recognised after owner intervention
cases.observed: Owner prompted formation, four agents subsequently exchanged 18 chat messages in child room. No evidence that the breakout was unused. Autonomous formation was not achieved.

cases.label: replacement misuse
cases.observed: After restart, an explicit warning said original processes were alive. One replacement marked the original seat left; two accepted recruits were stopped, while two other requests were refused. One displacement incident, not four successful replacements.

cases.label: historical liveness and policy friction already fixed
cases.observed: Chair launched six successors after launcher timeout; two explicit Codex requests were substituted with Claude under a hub pin. Six dead-seat kick votes needed nine ballots. Five later recruits hit the 45-minute limit. Chair reports both kick and timeout defects fixed before round three; round-three Codex requests launched as Codex. Do not present these as new unfixed defects.

case_review_limit: Two rooms provide the specifically adjudicated coordination incidents above; the other four supplied reports and telemetry context, not an exhaustive opportunity audit.
